info.title: Logistic Browser Demo Contract (MSW)
info.description: Browser-only MSW demo and extension examples. This is not the implemented .NET backend Swagger contract: plural warehouse routes, auth/me, sales, dashboard and user management must not be treated as live backend endpoints. Current live routes and limits are documented in API-CONTRACT.md; authoritative live OpenAPI is https://localhost:7228/swagger/v1/swagger.json. Demo DTO validation and atomicity rules do not imply matching backend implementation.
